products.title: Riiffs Goodness Oud Purple Wave Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Goodness Oud Purple Wave Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex scent from Riiffs Perfumes. It opens fresh and creamy with saffron, rose and lemon, which feels bright and slightly spicy at the start. The middle brings soft floral jasmine sambac, mixed with smooth ambroxan, for a clean, warm feel. Base notes of tonka bean, amber and vanilla add sweet warmth and depth, making the scent feel cozy, creamy and long lasting for daily wear or special outings.

products.title: Afnan 9PM Elixir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan 9PM Elixir Eau de Parfum is a bold and modern unisex fragrance from the house of Afnan. Launched in 2025, this perfume is rich, warm and slightly spicy with a smooth, sweet touch. It starts with powerful spicy notes that are lively and strong, then gradually transitions to a soft heart of leather and lavender. The vanilla and patchouli base at the end creates a milky, warm and soothing feeling. Afnan 9PM Elixir Eau de Parfum feels classy but is still easy to wear.

products.title: Mancera Cedrat Boise Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Mancera Cedrat Boise Eau De Parfum is a bright, fresh, and modern unisex fragrance that mixes juicy citrus with smooth woods and soft musk. Inspired by sunny days and easy elegance, this perfume opens with a splash of zesty Sicilian lemon, refreshing bergamot, and a hint of spicy black currant. As it settles, fruity notes blend with soft jasmine and earthy patchouli leaf, adding depth and charm. The dry-down is warm and creamy with cedar, leather, vanilla, and white musk that stay on your skin for hours.

Mancera Cedrat Boise is a perfect everyday fragrance for people who love fresh, energetic scents with a classy twist. It feels youthful yet sophisticated, making it a favourite for both men and women who want to smell fresh, clean, and stylish all day long.

products.title: Versace Eros Man Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Versace Eros Man Eau De Parfum is a bold, fresh, and sensual men’s fragrance inspired by the Greek god of love Eros. Just like its name, this perfume is all about passion and power. It opens with an amazing blast of mint, sweet candy apple, and zesty citrus fruits. As it settles, warm ambroxan and fresh geranium add depth and masculinity. Finally, a smooth blend of vanilla, cedar, and leather wraps you in a warm, confident finish.

Versace Eros Man Eau De Parfum is perfect for modern men who want to feel strong, attractive, and unforgettable. A few sprays will boost your confidence and turn heads wherever you go.

products.title: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Eau De Parfum is an impressive, smooth, and elegant leather fragrance which has a rich and profound character. It starts with the spicy touch of cardamom, which is at once fresh and a little warm. In no time, strong leather notes along with soft jasmine give a powerful yet clean impression. Deep and long-lasting scent is achieved by the combination of amber, moss, and patchouli at the base. The fragrance strikes as being steadfast, contemporary, and fashionably, ideal for those who appreciate powerful and elegant scents.

products.title: Lattafa Jasoor Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Jasoor Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume that gives a bold and confident vibe. Launched in 2023 by the house of Lattafa, it brings a fresh and spicy mix that feels both clean and deep. The perfume opens with juicy apple, spicy cardamom and fresh bergamot. The middle notes brings in warm tobacco, lavender and floral geranium. The dry-down is rich with tonka bean, leather, vetiver and patchouli.

products.title: Ibraheem Al Qurashi Blue Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Blue Oud Eau de Parfum is a deep and strong fragrance that combines rich oud with soft floral notes. It starts with a smooth combination of oud and blue lilies, giving a fresh yet dark feeling. The middle becomes warm with leather and patchouli, adding a bold touch. In the last, you get sweet amber and smoky tobacco, which make the scent feel cosy, elegant, and long-lasting. It is a beautiful combination of luxury and softness, suitable for both men and women.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Marj Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Marj Eau de Parfum is a unisex floriental fragrance by the Ahmed Al Maghribi fragrance house launched in 2023. It is a beautiful and graceful balance of numerous scent notes, which could have given messy results without fine blending. Marj has oud, honey, pink pepper, elemi, nutmeg, bergamot, and mandarin for its top layer; jasmine, cashmere wood, vetiver, orange blossom, cinnamon, patchouli, and saffron for the heart; and musk, ambergris, raspberry, oakmoss, saffron, pear, amber, agarwood, sandalwood, leather, and violet for the base of the composition.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum is a bold, aromatic fragrance made for men who love rich, smoky, and spicy scents. This perfume mixes fresh herbs, warm spices, deep resins, and dark woods to create a unique scent that feels powerful and masculine.

Inspired by the mystery of smoky incense burning in a grand hall, Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum wraps you in layers of fresh bergamot, spicy oregano, and herbal notes. As it settles, the heart opens with opoponax, warm amber, and labdanum that add a smooth sweetness. Finally, the base brings strong smoky notes, oud, leather, and earthy patchouli that stay on your skin for hours.

If you want to stand out at any party, wedding, or special dinner, Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum will make sure you get noticed for your bold and classy taste.

products.title: Maison Margiela Replica Jazz Club Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Maison Margiela Replica Jazz Club Eau De Toilette is a warm, smooth and cozy scent made to feel like a relaxed night in a dim jazz bar. The fragrance is opens with bright and spicy top notes of pink pepper, neroli and lemon that form the opening. It appears then, the middle notes of sweet rum, vetiver and clary sage are mixed. The fragrance then draws to an end with a mixture of tobacco leaf, vanilla bean and styrax, which is soft and warm on the skin.

products.title: Lattafa Qaeed Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Qaeed Eau De Parfum is a creamy, warm and bold unisex perfume from the house of Lattafa. It has a strong oriental style with sweet spices, deep woods, soft leather and smoky oud. The opening is spicy with cinnamon, cardamom, and bergamot. The heart has saffron, sandalwood, cedar and carnation, giving a warm and creamy feel. The dry down becomes sweet, woody and slightly smoky with oud, vanilla, leather and amber.

products.title: Mancera Red Tobacco Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Red Tobacco Eau De Parfum is a bold and heavy unisex scent known for its rich, smoky and sweet spicy style. It starts loud with warm cinnamon, oud, incense, saffron, nutmeg and some fruity green apple and pear. Then it melts into a simple heart of patchouli and jasmine. The dry down comes strong with thick tobacco, sweet vanilla, amber, sandalwood, guaiac wood, white musk and vetiver.

products.title: Rayhaan Corium Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Corium Eau de Parfum is a bold, masculine scent. Rayhaan Corium Eau de Parfum was released in 2023 and carries a dark, warm profile built around chestnut, spices and elemi in the opening; aromatic sage in the middle and a deep base of vanilla, leather and oud. The mixture feels creamy, slightly sweet and smoky with a strong leather tone that gives a classy yet powerful vibe.

products.title: Lattafa Velvet Oud Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Velvet Oud Eau De Parfum is a deep, warm and bold unisex scent from the house of Lattafa. It mixes smoky incense, rich leather, strong oud, warm amber and soft musk into a thick, dark cloud of sweet, smoky woods. The scent opens with a hint of citrus that feels bright for a few seconds but quickly melts into spicy cinnamon, heavy oud, and warm amber. It is known for its dark and powerful aura, making it a perfect pick for people who love strong Arabic-style perfumes.

products.title: Lattafa Teriaq Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Teriaq Eau de Parfum is a new fragrance for men and women released in 2024. It is a sweet, warm fragrance that feels playful at first and then turns rich and deep as it settles. It opens with caramel, apricot, almond and a little pink pepper spark. In the heart you get honey, soft white flowers, rose and a touch of rhubarb. The base is warm and cozy with leather, vanilla, labdanum, musk and vetiver.

products.title: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Ombré Leather Parfum is an intense, velvety, and daring leather fragrance that exudes sophistication and luxury. It starts with a delicate green hint of violet leaf and dry cedar, then gradually transitions to a pure floral heart with jasmine and orris. The foundation is a blend of leather, wood notes, and a faintly tobacco-like smell, which are all three very strong. This fragrance gives off a powerful, self-assured, and contemporary vibe which is ideal for those who are fans of leather perfumes with a strong presence.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Laathani Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Laathani Extrait de Parfum is a rich, bold and graceful unisex fragrance from the house of Ahmed Al Maghribi Fragrances known for its beast-level longivity and projection. It is a find blend of fresh bergamot and fruity pear top, floral rosemary and warm oud heart, and smoky bakhoor and heavy leather base.

products.title: Guy Laroche Drakkar Noir Eau De Toilette For Men
products.body_html: Drakkar Noir is a classic men’s fragrance with a bold, fresh, and clean scent. It opens with sharp citrus and herbs like lemon, lavender, and rosemary that feel very energising. Then it moves into spicy and green notes such as juniper, coriander, and jasmine that add depth. The base is warm, earthy, and masculine with oakmoss, leather, vetiver, fir, and patchouli. It is a timeless scent that many men use for daily wear, evenings, and even gym days because it smells confident and strong.

products.title: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Eau De Parfum is a captivating, luxurious, and warm men's scent with a mellow almond top note that is mixed with spices, lavender, bergamot, rosemary, and thyme. The middle consists of cherries, vanilla, incense, and soft rose. The base note is of very leather, tonka bean, and sandalwood. This perfume is known for its sweetness-woodiness balance that has a lasting and elegant feel on the skin. It has earned a special place among the fragrance community for its powerful projection, velvety blending of different notes, and sophisticated gentlemanly vibe.

products.title: French Avenue Azzure Aoud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Azzure Aoud Eau de Parfum is a strong and dominant perfume for men with warm, fruity, and deep notes. The introduction is a pleasant fruity mix that is infused with rose and saffron to produce a smooth but slightly spicy taste. The robust oud evolves over time with patchouli and benzoin in order to establish a complex, dark atmosphere. The bottom part of the combines leather and wood materials with soft fabrics and creates a long-lasting and powerful smell that comprises vanilla and amber.

products.title: Dunhill Icon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Icon Eau de Parfum is a classy and timeless perfume for men that combines modern freshness with warm woods. Launched in 2015, it brings together citrusy top notes of neroli and bergamot, followed by a spicy core of black pepper, lavender and cardamom. The base is creamy and masculine with vetiver, oakmoss, leather, iris and oud. It’s a perfume that wraps around you a feeling of elegance, confidence and being dressed up throughout the day.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Summer Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Summer Oud Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance from Ahmed Al Maghribi Fragrances. Launched in 2022, it is a refreshing and warm scent with a perfect summer vibe. The scent has a bright and fresh opening formed by the very top notes of saffron, mandarin orange, incense and cypriol. The fragrance then gets warmer and sweeter thanks to the middle notes of rose, cashmere wood, caramel, amber and patchouli. The skin is then treated with a long lasting, rich and smooth trail created by the base of oud, leather, musk, oakmoss and vetiver.

products.title: Mancera  Cedrat Boise Intense Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Cedrat Boise Intense Extrait de Parfum is a deeper, more decadent version of the original Cedrat Boise. This Mancera Cedrat Boise Intense Extrait de Parfum feels bolder, smoother and more long lasting on the skin. It starts with fresh citrus aromas, blended with black currant and spice, for a sharp, classy opening. Leather, sandalwood, oud, patchouli and jasmine all intertwine and combine to form a warm, rather smoky heart as it settles. It is creamy, musky at the base, contains ambergris, oakmoss, vanilla and white musk and lasts hours and hours on the skin.

products.title: Dumont Nitro White Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Nitro White Eau de Parfum is a stylish and modern scent made for confident men. Launched in 2024, it opens with a clean, fresh touch of Juniper Berries, Iris and Cypress, which give it a cool and classy start. The middle adds Myrrh and Patchouli which offer a smooth and deep warmth. And the base combination of Honey, Vanilla, Amber, Musk and Leather provides a strong, masculine and comforting finish.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy Noir Eau de Parfum is a dark, classy, and mysterious fragrance for men and women who love bold and spicy scents. This perfume opens with a fresh touch of bergamot, violet, and spruce that adds a green, crisp feel. As the scent settles, you get warm notes of leather, pine tree, and lavender, which bring a smooth, deep vibe. The base of patchouli and labdanum adds richness and makes this fragrance last long.

Afnan Supremacy Noir Eau de Parfum feels powerful yet elegant, perfect for evening wear, parties, or when you want to feel confident and stylish. It leaves a warm, spicy trail that gets you compliments wherever you go.

products.title: Premium Vegan Leather Travel Case
products.body_html: Elevate your fragrance experience on the go with our luxurious vegan leather travel case. Designed with precision and style, it features 4 slots to securely hold atomizers along with 6 additional refill slots - 3 each for 5ml & 10ml refills. The soft inner lining ensures your vials stay protected, while the sleek foldable design with snap-button closure makes it perfect for travel or gifting. A must-have for fragrance lovers who value elegance and practicality!

products.title: Azzaro  Forever Wanted Elixir Parfum
products.body_html: Azzaro Forever Wanted Elixir Parfum is a powerful and fashionable perfume that is deep, bold, and contemporary men perfume. It starts with a plump touch of raspberry blended with fresh green mandarin and bergamot and it has a slightly sweet fresh start. Warm spices and soft lavender trickle out slowly and the smell becomes smooth and manly. The leather bottom is opulent and strong, remaining in contact with skin a long time. The perfume is perfect for men who prefer bold and strong smells.

products.title: Azzaro Wanted By Night Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Azzaro Wanted By Night Eau De Parfum is a bold, deep, and mysterious fragrance designed for the modern man who lives confidently and makes a strong impression. Launched in 2018, Azzaro Wanted By Night EDP brings a unique blend of spicy cinnamon, fresh citrus, and rich woody notes, making it a perfect scent for evenings, special events, and cooler days.

Wanted By Night Eau De Parfum is intense and sensual, made for those who own the night. With its warm, spicy character and deep masculine vibe, Azzaro Wanted By Night is often described as charismatic and seductive, ideal for parties, dates, and night outs.

products.title: Rayhaan Cordova Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Cordova Eau de Parfum is a bold and smooth men’s fragrance. Rayhaan Cordova Eau de Parfum was launched in 2023. It carries a strong leather woody scent profile built with leather (top note), patchouli and cypress (middle notes) and amber, woody notes and vetiver (base notes).

products.title: Montblanc Explorer Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Montblanc Explorer Eau De Parfum is a modern men’s perfume made for guys who like a clean, fresh and a little bit woody kind of smell. It starts with a very refreshing note of the bergamot and a gentle spicy tone. The middle notes are quite heavy due to the combination of leather and Haitian vetiver. The base contains smooth notes of ambroxan, akigalawood, patchouli leaf and a very slight touch of cacao sweetness.

products.title: French Avenue Moonstone Bleu Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Moonstone Bleu Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume with a cool, clean and slightly dark feel. It opens with fresh watery and metallic notes mixed with peppery spice, giving a sharp and airy start. As it settles, soft florals, beeswax and leather come in, adding smooth warmth and depth. The base feels creamy and comforting with musk, honey, woods, and amber.

products.title: Tom Ford Tuscan Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Tuscan Leather Eau De Parfum is a powerful and daring leather scent that gives the impression of being luxurious, dark and elegant. The beginning of the fragrance is a little fruity with the raspberry combined with the saffron, which gives the impression of being a bit sweet and spicy. Gradually, it goes to the smoky and floral heart that feels deep and smooth. The base is all leather and suede, and it is warm, powerful, and long-lasting. This perfume is confident, mature, and luxurious, and it is ideal for bold fragrance lovers.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Oud Azraq Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Oud Azraq Eau de Parfum is a rich and deep unisex fragrance made for people who enjoy bold oud scents with sweetness. It opens with a smooth honey note merged with dark agarwood, giving a warm and slightly sweet start. The middle contains spicy cinnamon entwined with rich, creamy vanilla and amber, which is pleasant and comforting. The base comprises patchouli and leather, creating a strong, staying Middle Eastern aura. It feels luxurious, warm and powerful, but still wearable.

products.title: Chopard Oud Malaki Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Chopard Oud Malaki Eau De Parfum is a bold men’s fragrance that combines smoky woods, leather, and spices with a warm and deep oud base. This scent shows true luxury and elegance, made for men who love strong and royal perfumes. It starts fresh with grapefruit and lavender, turns deep with tobacco and leather, and finally settles into a base of oud, ambergris, and dark woods that gives a classy and long-lasting scent trail.

products.title: Lattafa Maahir Black Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Maahir Black Eau De Parfum is a bold and deep oriental scent made for both men and women. It starts with the spiciness of black pepper, pink pepper and saffron, which are all together giving a powerful and fresh beginning. The middle note combines smoky cade oil with labdanum, balsam and rhubarb for a dark, warm and rich feeling. Finally, the base of smooth leather, cedar, guaiac wood, patchouli, moss and musk creates a fragrant, lasting and classy perfume.

products.title: French Avenue Coco Morado Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Coco Morado Eau de Parfum is a bold and deep unisex fragrance for those who enjoy dark, sweet and woody scents. It opens with spicy warmth from cinnamon, saffron, nutmeg and ginger, which feels creamy and slightly sharp at first. As the perfume settles, you start getting heavy oud, incense, dates, caramel and amberwood notes that feel sweet, smoky and resin like. In the dry down, leather, vanilla, cacao butter, musk and patchouli come together to give a creamy, warm and long lasting base that feels luxurious and strong.

products.title: Paco Rabanne One Million Golden Oud Parfum
products.body_html: Paco Rabanne One Million Golden Oud Parfum is a prosperous and bold men's perfume from the house of Rabanne. It launched in 2023 and is a deep, warm scent made with spicy, woody and leathery notes that feel royal and strong. It begins spicy and fresh using saffron, nutmeg, black pepper and bergamot. The middle is a smooth mixture of woody patchouli, gurjan balsam and sandalwood. The base is dark, warm and long lasting, using oud, leather, cedarwood and labdanum.

products.title: Lattafa Ishq Al Shuyukh Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ishq Al Shuyukh Gold Eau de Parfum is a rich, warm and creamy scent for both men and women. Starting with a golden soft and sweet mix of caramel and saffron, the heart contains suede, leather and tonka bean which smooth out the scent and give it depth. The vanilla, amber and musk in the base provide a long-lasting warm and pleasant trail.

products.title: French Avenue Moonstone Noire Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Moonstone Noire Eau de Parfum is a dark, smooth and classy unisex fragrance from the house of French Avenue. Launched in 2024, this scent focuses on deep leather tones mixed with woody and creamy notes. The fragrance opens softly and slowly becomes creamy and warm, making it perfect for people who like bold but balanced perfumes.

products.title: Mancera  Red Tobacco Intense Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Red Tobacco Intense Extrait de Parfum is a very strong, bold and dark fragrance made for people who love heavy scents. This was launched in 2023 as a more powerful and creamier version of the original Red Tobacco. It opens spicy and smoky, then slowly turns warm, sweet and woody. The high oil concentration makes it long lasting and very intense, so even small sprays are enough.

products.title: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Leather Eau de Parfum is a bold and luxurious unisex fragrance. Introduced in 2017, it literally combines all the notes of the fresh, spicy, and warm fragrance family making the whole composition leather-centric and smooth. The fruity and spicy mix of juniper berries, cardamom, pink pepper, and raspberry marks up the top notes. The middle has the floral and slightly hot scent of iris, ginger, and rose. The bottom or base note is composed of a combination of leather, white musk, and amber, which are rich and sensual thus leaving a long-lasting impression.

products.title: French Avenue Spectre Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Spectre Eau de Parfum is a dark, bold and smoky leather men’s perfume made for those who like strong scents. It was launched in 2023 and opens with incense, gaiac wood and saffron, which feels warm and mysterious. The middle brings leather with a soft, sweet touch from violet and sugar cane. The base is deep and smoky with patchouli, sandalwood, woods and black musk that stays long on skin. Overall, French Avenue Spectre Eau de Parfum feels powerful, mature and very confident.

products.title: French Avenue Aromatix X Carnal Desire Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Aromatix X Carnal Desire Extrait de Parfum is a powerful and enticing perfume that is suitable for women and men to use. It starts off with a sweet, fruity raspberry smell that is mixed with fresh bergamot and light cinnamon spice. The aroma becomes sweet, creamy and comprises cotton candy, soft rose, and powdery orris. The dry down has a thick, dense fragrance that mixes leather, oud, vanilla, and wood notes that last long after application in the skin.

products.title: Lacoste L.12.12 Blanc Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lacoste L.12.12 White is a pure, refreshing, and laid-back scent that was created for men who prefer to wear something that is simple yet elegant. The opening is very fresh and consists of grapefruit blended with spicy notes, which is very lively and sporty. The fragrance softens with time and the light floral notes participate in making the whole aroma even smoother and more balanced. The drydown features a combination of wood and light leather that forms a clean masculine finish which is very tranquil, refreshing, and inviting throughout the day.

products.title: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Infrared Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Infrared Eau De Parfum is a fiery and daring scent for men that is characterized by its spicy, smoky and powerful facets. The first impression is a very strong one of cinnamon and chili pepper that feels warm and adrenaline-pumping. Gradually, the rich leather note reveals itself and adds a dark, manly aspect. The woodsy and resinous base is smooth and lingers on the skin for a long time. This scent exudes power, confidence and is definitely for men who are fond of strong perfumes.

products.title: Prada L'Homme Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Prada L’Homme Intense Eau de Parfum is a bold, classy, and deep men’s fragrance at the same time. The fragrance opens with a loud iris note that is clean, powdery, and elegant at the same time. Intense warmth from amber and patchouli slowly comes in and gives the fragrance a rich and slightly dark vibe. The base of leather, tonka bean, and sandalwood makes it creamy, woody, and long-lasting. This fragrance exudes maturity, confidence, and is perfect for men who appreciate strong yet clean scents.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Lutfah The Seventh Heaven Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Lutfah The Seventh Heaven Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume. Launched in 2024, this fragrance feels rich, warm and slightly spicy with a deep Arabic touch. It opens with a fresh spicy mix of pink pepper, bright Sicilian bergamot and sweet davana that feels uplifting and classy. The heart is warm and resinous with white amber, agarwood and herbal rosemary, giving a calm but powerful feel. The base is deep and long lasting with leather, earthy Haitian vetiver, and soft musk that stays on skin for hours and feels luxurious.

products.title: Guerlain Shalimar Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain Shalimar Eau De Parfum is one of those perfumes that are warm, daring, and classic all at once, and the oriental richness is definitely the main reason for its popularity among perfume lovers. It starts with citrus notes, illuminating bergamot and lemon, then goes into a deep floral-earthy heart consisting of iris, jasmine, rose, vetiver, and patchouli, finally ending in a soft base of vanilla, incense, leather, sandalwood, and musk. It is perceived as classic, smooth, slightly smoky, and elegant with a very effortless touch.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Kouros Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Yves Saint Laurent Kouros Eau de Toilette is a powerful and timeless scent for men that projects an image of boldness, cleanliness, and strength. It starts with a crisp and fresh odor that is very cheerful and somewhat spicy, then gradually changes to warmth and depth. The combination of herbs, flowers, and animalic notes gives it a very masculine and assured character. This fragrance is a classic, heavy, and best suited for the men who appreciate strong perfumes.

products.title: Guerlain Vetiver Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Guerlain Vetiver Eau de Toilette is a clean, fresh, and classic men’s perfume with a bright citrus start, warm spices, and earthy woody notes that stay smooth on the skin. It opens with bergamot, lemon, nutmeg, neroli, coriander, tobacco, and mandarin orange, followed by middle notes of vetiver, pepper, carnation, sage, sandalwood, and orris root. The scent dries down to vetiver, oakmoss, leather, tonka bean, amber, civet, and myrrh, giving a natural and timeless feel.

products.title: Roja Parfums Elysium Pour Homme
products.body_html: Roja Parfums Elysium Pour Homme Parfum Cologne is a fresh, clean and classy men’s fragrance from the luxury house of Roja Parfums. The fragrance shines with its top note of vibrant citruses that impart an energetic and contemporary feel. The middle note reveals a combination of green, fruity and lightly spicy scents that embody smoothness and confidence. The warm, velvety and slightly buttery base of the concoction contributes a richness and longevity, thus making it hard to miss and very alluring. It smells elegant, masculine and very uplifting, perfect for men who like fresh but premium perfumes.

products.title: Lattafa Art of Nature 1 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Art of Nature Eau de Parfum is a luxurious unisex scent that blends the magic of nature with rich oriental notes. Launched in 2024, this perfume carries the freshness of fruits and the depth of woody warmth. It starts with figs, plums, and blackcurrants, which are of the best quality and then very slowly dissolve into the gentle center of leather, rhubarb, and rose. The base holds deep oud, smooth ambergris, and creamy vanilla, leaving an elegant and long-lasting trail on your skin.

products.title: Paris Corner Khair Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Khair Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex fragrance. Launched in 2023, it carries a warm oriental woody scent profile that blends fruity herbal freshness with deep woody richness. The opening starts with davana, bergamot and pink pepper, giving a slightly sweet spicy feel. The heart unfolds into creamy agarwood, oud, amber and rosemary that create a warm aromatic body. The base settles into leather, vetiver and musk, which adds depth, softness and a long lasting trail. The blend feels smooth, bold and balanced with a classy Middle Eastern touch.

products.title: Lattafa Ra'ed Silver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ra’ed Silver Eau de Parfum is a warm and spicy unisex scent with a bright citrus opening and a deep, sweet, woody base. It starts with fresh hints of citruses, spices and mandarin orange, then moves into a rich heart of cinnamon, saffron, amber and cloves. The base settles into soft vanilla, musk, leather, oud and a touch of ambergris.

products.title: Guerlain Habit Rouge Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain Habit Rouge Eau De Parfum for men is a lavish and classy scent with an excellent combination of warm and woody tones. The fragrance starts off with fresh and lively bergamot, which is combined with the soft feel of rum and vanilla in the middle, then ends with a strong base of patchouli. This perfume was made by Delphine Jelk in 2024 and is very much appreciated for its elegant smell and stamina, hence, it is perfect for nighttime or special events.

products.title: Penhaligon's Halfeti Leather Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Penhaligon's Halfeti Leather Eau de Parfum is a powerful and mysterious leather scent that is unisex. The fragrance begins with a delicate combination of plum, cardamom, and fresh citrus that is warm and somewhat spicy. Gradually, rose, nutmeg, and cinnamon unfold revealing a profound and elegant character. At the end of the process, leather, oud, and incense remain robust and smoky. The impression received from this fragrance is dauntless, sumptuous and just right for self-assured perfume users.

products.title: Calvin Klein DEFY Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Calvin Klein DEFY Eau de Parfum is a bold men’s fragrance that was launched in 2022 this scent brings a confident balance of fresh spice, smooth leather and earthy wood. The fragrance opens with a spark of Mandarin Orange and black pepper giving a bright yet spice start and the middle with saffiano leather and suede adding a refined and daring tone and at the base Haitian Vetiver anchors the scent with depth and power. It is made for men who like to break limits and show their fearless side.

products.title: Tom Ford Fucking Fabulous Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Fucking Fabulous Eau de Parfum is a bold, rich and very confident unisex perfume from the luxury house of Tom Ford. It was revealed in 2017 and it is famous for the full bodied leather combined with the warm and creamy notes. It starts with the fresh and sweet scent of lavender and clary sage, which gives a pure but also an edgy beginning. The middle is very strong and very much like leather, burnt almond, vanilla and orris, holding the sweetness but still being powerful. The base remains long with leather, tonka bean, cashmeran, white woods and amber, creating a warm, sexy and lasting trail.

products.title: Rasasi La Yuqawam Tobacco Blaze Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi La Yuqawam Tobacco Blaze Eau De Parfum is a daring and dark oriental men’s perfume for those who appreciate strong and profound scents. It starts with a combination of spicy saffron, fresh neroli and light floral notes. As it settles, you can smell sweet apricot, warm amber and woody cedar that gives it richness. The final stage of the fragrance is very powerful and manly with leather, oud and patchouli that give the impression of being smoky, warm and powerful.

products.title: Narciso Rodriguez Bleu Noir Parfum
products.body_html: Narciso Rodriguez Bleu Noir Parfum is a deep, elegant men’s fragrance from the designer house of Narciso Rodriguez. Released in 2022, it is a smooth woody musk scent with a modern dark twist. The scent opens fresh and spicy with cardamom, citrus and cypress, then moves into a soft heart of iris, musk and suede. The base is creamy and warm with sandalwood, leather, vetiver and tonka bean, giving it a clean yet sensual masculine feel that works all year.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Nuit de Feu Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Nuit de Feu Eau De Parfum is a deep and smoky unisex scent that feels warm, dark and very rich. The scent is characterized by very strong incense, leather, oud, olibanum, and musk notes, which altogether make up a bold fragrance that is sure to be remembered on the skin.

products.title: French Avenue Chocola Addict Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Chocola Addict Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex fragrance with a rich chocolate feel. Launched in 2025, this scent is warm, sweet and a little dark in nature. It opens with creamy chocolate mixed with fresh tangerine and soft amber, which gives a sweet yet smooth start. The middle note feels bold with leather and smoky incense, adding depth and character. Overall, French Avenue Chocola Addict Eau de Parfum is cozy, addictive and perfect for people who love chocolate based perfumes with a slightly bold touch.

products.title: Franck Olivier Oud Touch Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Franck Olivier Oud Touch Eau De Parfum is very deep and rich. It feels warm, kinda Middle Eastern. It is fancy and bold. They made Oud Touch in 2014. It starts sweet. You smell caramel, raspberry, and orange. This is a smooth, little fruity start. Next, you smell flowers and earth. That is rose, jasmine, and patchouli. This mixes well with the last smells. Those are amber, vanilla, and musk. Franck Olivier Oud Touch is for guys who want a smell that is strong and stays a long time. Oud Touch is nice but easy to wear. It is best for nighttime or big events. The sweet and warm wood smell is perfect. It makes people remember you.

products.title: Issey Miyake Nuit D'issey Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Issey Miyake Nuit D’Issey Eau De Toilette is a deep, mysterious, and bold men’s perfume that feels like the calm of night. It opens with fresh grapefruit and bergamot, giving a bright but sharp start. The middle slowly turns warm with leather, woods, spices, black pepper, and a hint of vetiver. The base settles into smoky incense, dark ebony wood, patchouli, and soft tonka bean. It smells confident, masculine, and powerful, perfect for men who like strong night fragrances.

products.title: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal L'Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain L'Homme Idéal L'Intense Eau de Parfum for men is a bold and intense fragrance with a perfect mix of spicy, woody, and sweet notes. It opens with sharp almond, chili pepper, and cardamom, followed by rich leather, Bulgarian rose, and labdanum in the heart. The dry-down is warm and comforting with smoke, tonka bean, vanilla, sandalwood, and patchouli. It’s highly praised for its long-lasting performance and elegant, masculine aura.

products.title: Fragrance World Varakh Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Fragrance World Varakh Gold Eau de Parfum is a luxurious and dignified perfume targeted at women who enjoy heavy and sophisticated aromas. It starts with a spicy bite of saffron and black pepper blended with fresh bergamot, and it is bold as one sprays the perfume. Gradually the odour turns warm and silky, including iris, balsam and soft woods. Its foundation is solid and lavishly oud, leather, patchouli, and sandalwood, with a long-lasting and superior touch

products.title: Acqua Di Parma Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Acqua di Parma Leather EDP for men and women is a sophisticated and luxurious evening perfume with a rich citrusy opening with Brazilian orange, Sicilian lemon, and raspberry top notes; aromatic and leather-balancing red thyme, rose, petitgrain, and honeysuckle heart notes; and a polished base of leather, cedarwood, and guaiac wood. It was formulated by François Demachy in 2019. 

It is highly praised among the fragrance community as a highly refined and exceptional blend of notes with a distinguished quality and satisfactory projection & sillage.

products.title: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Dark Leather Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Dark Leather Eau de Parfum is an intense, spicy, and daring fragrance for men that primarily conveys the aroma of powerful leather. The scent starts with a pungent combination of black pepper and nutmeg that gives the impression of heat and vigor. In a while, sweet cinnamon, and incense start to unfold, thereby making the fragrance deep and powerful. The foundation of leather and tobacco is a bit harsh, manly, and everlasting. This perfume is an impression of strength, confidence, and it is meant for men who prefer dusky, strong fragrances.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shumoukh Al Ghutra Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shumoukh Al Ghutra Eau de Parfum is a bold and classy leather based fragrance made for men who like strong yet clean scents. It initiates with the fresh and a bit green note of the apple and soft violet along with galbanum. When it becomes stable, the rich leather and dry cedar emerge, giving a masculine and confident air to the fragrance. The base is smooth and warm with vanilla and musk, thus making the scent everlasting and soothing yet still light.

products.title: Montale Aoud Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Montale Aoud Leather Eau De Parfum is a strong and bold unisex perfume that mixes rich oud with clean, warm leather. It is a deep and smooth scent that gives a powerful first impression and keeps the same strength for long hours. A mix of leather, oud, saffron, bergamot, cardamom, pepper and ambergris creates a smoky, spicy and warm smell that feels both classy and wild.

products.title: Guerlain Habit Rouge Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Habit Rouge Eau de Toilette, a quintessentially oriental woody perfume for men, introduces its presence with the brightness of citrus and spices, then relaxes into the warmth of leather and vanilla. It has a character that is both timeless, luxurious, and slightly daring at the same time, thereby being suitable for men who prefer mature and assertive scents. It was the work of Jean-Paul Guerlain in 1988 and is still appreciated for its opulent and sophisticated character.

products.title: Guerlain Absolus Allegoria Cuir Intense Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain Absolus Allegoria Cuir Intense is a rich and heavy leather perfume designed for both females and males. It is lush, creamy and somewhat smoky at the onset. Designed by Thierry Wasser in 2024, this perfume is a great leather feel that is pleasant and classy simultaneously. It has the confident feel to it and it is ideal to those who like strong, classy and long-lasting perfumes.

products.title: Parfums De Marly Haltane Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Parfums De Marly Haltane Eau De Parfum graciously accepts the entry of manly character. Its scent profile is rich, green, and woody. For sure, the first impression is the invigorating fusion of lavender, clary sage, and bergamot that radiate cleanliness and sophistication. Eventually, the warm saffron with the sweet praline take the lead, providing a soft and velvety feel. The base of oud and cedar is deep, and woody, and has the longest tenacity that is why this fragrance is beautifully bold, refined, and potent.

products.title: Lattafa Raghba for Man Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Raghba for Man Eau de Parfum is a warm, fresh and slightly sweet men’s perfume from the house of Lattafa. It opens with bright lemon and soft iris, giving a clean and crisp feel. After that, the perfume is the green, somewhat powdery heart of violet leaf. The end is sweet and manly with sandalwood, leather, ambergris and cedar.

products.title: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Eau de Toilette is a stylish and fresh perfume for men, perfect for daily wear or casual evenings. It opens with fresh citrusy and aromatic notes, then moves into a smooth almond and tonka bean heart, finishing with a warm and masculine base of leather, cedar, and vetiver. It is loved by men for its balanced and long-lasting scent that feels natural yet sophisticated.

products.title: Guerlain  L'Homme Ideal Extreme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain L'Homme Idéal Extrême Eau de Parfum for men is a bold and sophisticated fragrance with a warm and spicy character. It opens with a fresh and nutty combination of almond, pink pepper, and bergamot, followed by a heart of plum, cinnamon, and heliotrope. The base dries down into creamy tobacco, leather, patchouli, and cedar. This EDP is loved for its classy, strong scent and long-lasting performance, perfect for evening or special occasions.

products.title: Byredo Black Saffron Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Byredo Black Saffron Eau de Parfum is a perfume for both men and women. It feels warm, a bit mysterious, and very rich when you wear it. The perfume is inspired by saffron, which is a very special spice. It has a combination of sweet, spicy, and earthy smell that make it bold but still very elegant.

The perfume start with saffron, juniper berries and fresh citrus from Chinese grapefruit, giving a spicy and bright opening. In the middle, you get soft leather and gentle black violet that add some depth and floral touch. Later it settle down into raspberry, cashmeran and vetiver, which give a woody, musky and little sweet finish that stay for long.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbanna The One Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dolce and Gabbana The One Intense perfume is a strong and dark men's perfume that has a smooth feel of leather. It is introduced with spicy cardamom blended with fresh neroli and cypress, which is fresh and crisp. Gradually, it becomes warm with the notes of cashmeran and soft resin that are warm and comfortable. The foundation contains leather and patchouli, which remain long on skin, which makes this smell powerful, elegant, and ideal among assertive men.

products.title: Burberry London Eau de Toilette
products.body_html:
Burberry London Eau de Toilette for Men is the perfect combination of British charm and timeless elegance. This fragrance captures the spirit of London, warm, classy, and effortlessly stylish. It opens with the freshness of bergamot and lavender, wrapped in the comforting spice of cinnamon. As it settles, rich leather and soft mimosa create a smooth, masculine heart, leading to a deep base of tobacco leaf, guaiac wood, oakmoss, and opoponax.

Burberry London Eau de Toilette feels like stepping into a cosy, high-end London gentleman’s club warm wood, leather chairs, and a touch of tobacco in the air. It’s sophisticated yet approachable, making it perfect for men who want to stand out with elegance.

products.title: Tom Ford Eau d' Ombre Leather Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Tom Ford Eau d ombre Leather Eau de Toilette is a men's fragrance made of leather. The fragrance is new and was introduced in 2024. The name behind this perfume is Sonia Constant. The cardamom, Ginger and Coriander are the top notes, Vanilla and Leather are the middle notes, and ambrofix is the base note. It starts spicy/ fresh and then goes smooth and a little sweet with soft leather. The dry down is warm, clean and contemporary. It is more daring yet easier to wear than the Eau de Parfum version, which is ideal for men who are fond of elegant leather perfumes.

products.title: Neesh Shafran Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Shafran Extrait de Parfum is a wealthy and bold unisex perfume launched in 2024 by the house of Neesh. It is a deep, woody, spicy scent that opens with warm saffron, fruity plum and spicy cardamom and nutmeg. The heart feels smooth and sweet with leather, caramel, brown sugar and soft cashmere wood. The base is dark and long lasting with incense, vanilla, amber, patchouli, sandalwood, moss and vetiver, creating a warm, strong scent trail that smells classy and powerful.

products.title: Acqua di Parma Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Acqua di Parma Oud Eau de Parfum is a rich and elegant oriental woody fragrance made for both men and women. It was launched in 2019 by the luxury brand Acqua di Parma, known for classy Italian scents. It opens with fresh orange and Calabrian bergamot, giving a clean citrus start. Then, amyris and coriander bring a warm woody spice. In the base, leather, sandalwood, cedar, musk and patchouli create a deep, smooth and long lasting finish.

products.title: Tom Ford Cherry Smoke Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Cherry Smoke Eau de Parfum is a bold, dark and seductive unisex perfume from the luxury house of Tom Ford. Launched in 2022, this scent is all about deep cherry mixed with smoke and leather. It opens with a rich sour cherry note touched with saffron, giving a slightly sweet but spicy feel. The heart feels warm and smooth with leather, olive, osmanthus and apricot, adding depth and richness. The base turns smoky and woody with nagarmotha, making it intense, mysterious and long lasting.

products.title: Rasasi Nafaeis Al Shaghaf Pour Femme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Nafaeis Al Shaghaf Pour Femme Eau De Parfum from Rasasi is a fragrance for women who love warm and creamy scents. The perfume is soft, sweet and elegant. The fragrance starts with a warm mix of almond, lemon and coffee that is creamy and slightly sweet. The middle turns floral with jasmine, tuberose, iris and lily, giving it a rich and feminine touch. The dry down reveals a warm and soft base consisting of vanilla, musk, sandalwood and amber, which is quite close to the skin and very satisfying. This perfume is simple, classy and easy to wear for daily use as well as special moments.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Privée Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Privée Eau de Parfum is an elegant yet bold women perfume that has a high quality leather fragrance. The perfume begins with light smoothness that goes on to form warm deep scent that is full of confidence and sophistication. The perfume offers a modern yet a trendy look that is powerful but not overly conspicuous. The perfume is comparable to the women who love strong, elegant perfumes, which provide a unique experience that is experienced throughout the day.

products.title: Men Date Night Discovery Set - Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Extreme, Versace Eros Flame, Guerlain L'homme Ideal
products.body_html:
Make a lasting impression with our Men Date Night Discovery Set, featuring three captivating fragrances:

  • Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Extreme EDP: Ignite the night with the intense blend of spices, vanilla, and tobacco, creating a warm and seductive scent.
  • Versace Eros Flame EDP: Embrace the passionate and vibrant notes of Italian citrus, black pepper, and vanilla, perfect for an unforgettable evening.
  • Guerlain L'Homme Ideal EDP: Experience the alluring combination of almond, leather, and tonka bean, delivering a sophisticated and magnetic fragrance.

Curated for romantic occasions, these fragrances are designed to captivate and enchant.

products.title: French Avenue Essence de Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Essence de Noir Eau de Parfum is a deep, smooth and elegant unisex fragrance introduced in 2022. It opens with soft powdery iris mixed with fresh cyclamen and juicy cassis, giving a calm but prosperous start. The heart feels floral and earthy with patchouli, rose and jasmine adding warmth and balance. As it dries down, vanilla, amber and leather come together to create a creamy, slightly sweet and bold base that stays close to skin and feels very luxurious.

products.title: My Perfumes Leather of Men Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: My Perfumes Leather Of Men Eau de Parfum is a bold and rich leather fragrance made for men who like strong and deep scents. It opens with a slightly sweet and spicy mix of raspberry, saffron and thyme, which feels unique and attention grabbing. In the middle, jasmine adds a soft touch. In the base, leather, amber and suede create a warm, smoky and long lasting finish that feels masculine and powerful.

products.title: Killian Straight to Heaven Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Killian Straight to Heaven Eau de Parfum is an intense, warm, and truly unforgettable fragrance for men. Inspired by adventure and freedom, this perfume combines the deep warmth of rum with exotic dried fruits, rich spices, and smooth woods. It feels bold yet smooth, giving you a confident vibe that lasts all day.

Killian Straight to Heaven Eau de Parfum is made for men who like to stand out. A splash of this perfume feels like stepping into a world of luxury, strong, stylish, and full of character. Perfect for evening parties, romantic nights, or when you want to feel your absolute best.

products.title: Xerjoff Tony Iommi Deified Parfum
products.body_html: Deified Tony Iommi Parfum by Xerjoff is a perfume that is utilised by women and men. In 2024, it released Deified Tony Iommi Parfum. The perfume starts with a luxurious and spicy blend of saffron, apple and cinnamon that is warm and a bit sweet. Leather and rose are added in heart to give a deep and smooth touch to the scent. The bottom of papyrus, patchouli, musk and moss provides a woody, ground and deep-seated end that is daring and extravagant.

products.title: Franck Boclet Erotic Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Franck Boclet Erotic Eau De Parfum for Men & Women is a strong perfume. It is an incredible blend of warm spice and smooth wood notes. The scent kicks off with a fresh burst of rosemary, lemon, bergamot, and basil. This gives it a clean, slightly spicy opening. The middle layer has a lot going on: benzoin, heliotrope, cardamom, patchouli, tuberose, lavender, and oakmoss. This adds a lot of depth, plus creamy sweetness and rich herbs. The bottom notes are heavy. You get vanilla, amber, incense, sandalwood, and leather. Musk and cedar soften the whole thing up. This makes the entire scent finish deep and totally luxurious.

products.title: Rasasi Qasamat Bareeq Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Qasamat Bareeq Eau De Parfum is a modern and lavish unisex fragrance that characterizes the house of Rasasi. It has clean and bright citrusy and fruity notes that come through fresh and a bit green. The scent, as it matures, gives off warmth, softness, spices, sweetness and a little floral fragrance. The base is strong and gentle with some leather, musk, woods and earth notes that last on the skin for many hours.

products.title: Maison Crivelli Oud Stallion Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Crivelli Oud Stallion Extrait de Parfum is a rich and bold unisex scent that mixes deep oud with warm spices and soft floral notes. The perfume opens with spicy hits of saffron, cardamom and Indonesian nutmeg. Then, the heart slowly turns into a floral combination of jasmine, osmanthus and Turkish rose. At the base, it settles into a dark and warm mix of agarwood (oud), leather, cedar, tonka and patchouli, giving it a strong and long-lasting finish.

products.title: Messi Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Montale Chocolate Greedy Eau de Parfum is a creamy, sweet and delicious gourmand fragrance made for people who love chocolate style scents. This perfume smells warm, cozy and edible, almost like fresh cocoa with vanilla and soft sweetness. The opening feels slightly bitter and deep, then slowly turns creamy and smooth on the skin. It is playful, comforting and very addictive, perfect for anyone who enjoys dessert like perfumes.

products.title: Men Luxe Discovery Set - Amouage Interlude, Louis Vuitton Afternoon Swim, Acqua Di Parma Leather
products.body_html:
Indulge in luxury with our Men Luxe Discovery Set, featuring three exceptional fragrances:

  • Amouage Interlude EDP: Immerse yourself in a complex blend of spices, amber, and smoky accords, delivering a rich and captivating scent.
  • Louis Vuitton Afternoon Swim EDP: Immerse yourself in a refreshing blend of citrus notes, delivering a vibrant and invigorating scent perfect for a sunlit adventure.
  • Acqua di Parma Leather EDP: Experience the refined leather accord, complemented by woody and citrus notes, embodying timeless luxury and sophistication.

Perfectly curated for the discerning gentleman, these scents exude opulence and class.

products.title: Byredo Tobacco Mandarin Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Byredo Tobacco Mandarin Extrait de Parfum is a unisex perfume that is rich and deep in smell, warm and spicy in nature. The perfume opens with a bitter combination of mandarin, cumin and coriander, which gives the fragrance a fresh but strong smell. The smell builds up into a dark and smooth smell, which has tobacco and leather as its main notes. The scent of the perfume is long-lasting, as the base components of oud, incense and sandalwood produce the strong and luxurious perfume-like aroma which prefer the deep-luxury scent lovers.
